name: Crossword
summary: Fresh crosswords built on your device, a daily puzzle, and your own word lists.
description: Generates a new crossword each time from a built-in bank of about 500 clues across eight subjects and three difficulty levels. Pick a size, a difficulty and the subjects you like, or play the daily puzzle that is the same for everyone that day. Paste your own list of words and clues to make a custom puzzle, save it, and print it with an optional answer page. Check or reveal a letter, a word or the whole grid, and keep your best time for each size. Everything runs on the device with no network.

records.purpose: Store puzzles in progress, custom puzzles, best times and the daily result
